records.prompt: Create ONE idle game sprite of a WWII Soviet-looking machine gun truck, strict vertical overhead orthographic view looking DIRECTLY DOWN at roofs, helmet crown and cargo floor, vehicle facing bottom of image, no horizon and no visible front-facing grille. Transparent background, 1024x1536 canvas with whole vehicle centered and clear margins. An olive-drab ZiS-5-inspired 1940s two-axle cargo lorry: boxy cab roof, long narrow hood at bottom, simple steel fenders, black tires visible at left/right, rectangular weathered wooden open cargo bed behind cab at top. Single DShK-style heavy machine gun on a central pedestal in cargo bed just behind cab, pointed forward toward bottom and slightly screen-right so the full long dark barrel and receiver are easily readable beside cab roof. One appropriately small Soviet gunner behind the weapon, olive steel helmet and khaki wartime uniform, both hands on grips, feet on wooden cargo floor. Modest ammunition box feeding gun. Small muted red star on hood. Truck unarmored: no tank turret, no modern pickup, no missiles, no quad mount, no canvas roof over cargo bed. Natural crew-to-truck proportions, gunner shoulders much narrower than bed. Use reference ONLY for painterly style and Soviet gunner uniform; do not copy reference handheld weapon. Polished stylized painted RTS art with clear clean shapes and restrained weathering, consistent with reference. Strict overhead role-readable silhouette at 48/64/128px, smooth finish, subdued green paint, brown wood and dark steel. No thick black outline, noise, glow, ground shadow, text or background. Single idle frame.

Edit the reference WWII Soviet machine-gun truck idle to use a TRUE 90-DEGREE VERTICAL OVERHEAD ORTHOGRAPHIC camera, as a flat overhead plan view. Change camera angle only; preserve olive-drab ZiS-5-inspired lorry, wooden open cargo bed, pedestal-mounted single heavy machine gun, khaki Soviet helmeted gunner, ammunition box, hood red star, smooth painted RTS style, proportions and forward direction toward bottom. Parallel sides, no perspective convergence, no isometric foreshortening. Four black tires partly visible outboard, truck front at bottom/rear at top. Single idle sprite on transparent 1024x1536 canvas, whole truck including mirrors and weapon in frame with generous margins. No ground shadow, background, text, extra guns, tank turret, changes to palette or equipment.
